links.kind: New structural calculation on all 13 historical maps; original closure results were already known. No new closure execution.

question: How many provisional degree-five coordinates remain after triangular rewriting from each of all 13 retained historical degree-four certificate maps?

claims.text: The reported border and working-coordinate counts are exact for the declared triangular rewrite rule; bit-payload arithmetic is conditional on those representations and is not measured RSS.

arms.description: Deterministic full-monomial enumeration on each retained map; no solver or checker rerun is attributed to this arm.
Independent enumeration direction: extend free degree-four monomials, deduplicate, test all deletions. Executed for every input.

aa.not_applicable_reason: Exact deterministic counts; no timing or stochastic comparison.

positive.not_applicable_reason: Software controls verify the full-free monomial set has binomial(N,D+1) border coordinates; these are separate unit fixtures, not scientific arms.

negative.not_applicable_reason: Software controls verify an all-pivot seed has zero border coordinates and malformed seeds are rejected; no statistical null population.

seed_derivation.note: No new random inputs; seed is a run identifier only.

instance_sampling.rule: All 13 certificates in results/certificates.txt, without selection.

blinding.how: Historical outcomes known; no statistical comparison.

power.note: Exhaustive historical list, deterministic verification, no population or power claim.

preflight_runtime.measured_on: Unmeasured conservative watchdog allowance; not a runtime estimate or measurement.

primary.name: provisional lifted quotient coordinates
primary.definition: Seed quotient dimension plus number of degree-five monomials all of whose degree-four divisors are seed unit representatives.

placement.checkpoint_detail: Write-once completed instance JSON; retry an interrupted profile only in a new run directory.

stopping_rules.rule: Profile every one of the thirteen frozen historical maps; no selection based on dimensions.
Hash, shape or triangularity rejection yields a failed record, never a closure or LFD conclusion.

invalidation_rules: Malformed or hash-mismatched certificate yields no capacity inference.
Payload calculation alone never admits a frontier run.

decision_rule.text: Record exact coordinate counts for each well-formed triangular seed; use them only to select and implement a memory-accounted producer.
decision_rule.threshold: Hash identity and validated monomial and triangular-map structure

outputs: per-instance structural counts and conditional bit payloads

graphs: working coordinate counts per retained seed; no timing graph

inadmissible: Calling profiling a degree-five closure run.
Treating estimated bit payloads as measured RSS or sufficient admission.
Assuming the seed kernel equals W4.
